limits.wayland: On this Wayland desktop, apps can't keep a window on top or choose where it appears, so the overlay may end up behind other windows and corner positions have no effect. Turn on “Compatibility mode (like TeamSpeak)” in the Voice settings and restart Mumcord: then the overlay stays on top.
limits.waylandKde: On KDE Plasma with Wayland, apps can't keep a window on top or choose where it appears. Two ways to fix that: let Mumcord add a KDE window rule for the overlay (“Set up automatically”), or turn on “Compatibility mode (like TeamSpeak)” in the Voice settings and restart Mumcord.
limits.exclusiveFullscreen: The overlay shows over windowed and borderless-fullscreen games. Games in exclusive fullscreen draw over every window, so switch them to “borderless” or “windowed fullscreen” to see the overlay.
